[SWS_DM_00970] Behavior of failed data element retrieval
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04199
⌈
If the retrieval of the
dataElement
failed due to an external processor has an er-
ror of
ara::diag::DiagUdsNrcErrorDomain
, the DM shall treat the
Diagnosti-
cEnvConditionFormulaPart
as condition not fulfilled and trigger a Log and Trace
message.
⌋
